comment: kiln.render's outlines (0.2.0-dev.30.3, issue #111): the game's own highlight on an entity's model instance. docs/re/client-render.md 'Highlight groups (outlines)', found on client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1...); the approach follows GreeneyeDS' Quick Deposit and Find (MIT). The renderer's setter SetGroups(renderer, Span<u32 model handle>*, Span<u8 group>*) writes the group byte of each instance (Instance(renderer, handle, 1): null for a stale handle) when it differs and marks the instance dirty; the game's render programs call it through RenderScene (scene + scene.renderer is the renderer). The two palette functions convert each group's colour (RenderSystemResource.highlightColorPalette) with ColorConvert(out, u32 colour) every frame; Kiln mid-hooks the conversion calls of Group1 and Group2 (pal.group1/2 = the resource offsets of their colours) to give them its colours. The client world's dynamic_render_model program, where Kiln applies the groups, is found by name through kiln.world, not here.

outline/SetGroups.comment: void SetGroups(Renderer*, const Span<u32>* handles, const Span<u8>* groups): per handle, Instance(renderer, handle, 1); when the instance's group byte (+inst.group) differs it is written and the instance marked dirty (flag 2)

outline/Instance.comment: u8* Instance(Renderer*, u32 handle, bool checked): handle = generation << 24 | index; null for 0 or a generation that does not match (the instance was destroyed); else the instance record. Also captured by SetGroups' call

outline/StaticModelReset.comment: static_render_model gives every model it makes group 0: SceneSetGroups(scene, {handle}, {0}) (the call is at +35). Captures SceneSetGroups, RenderScene's forwarder of SetGroups

outline/DynamicModelSet.comment: dynamic_render_model gives a model the entity's HighlightColor index (0 when it has none) when it makes the model or the index is set: SceneSetGroups(scene, {handle}, {index}) (the call is at +55). A second capture of SceneSetGroups

outline/SceneForward.comment: the forwarder itself (= SceneSetGroups): mov rcx, [rcx + scene.renderer]; jmp SetGroups. Gives the RenderScene -> renderer offset Kiln reads in the render program

outline/Palette0.Group1.comment: the first palette function's call that converts Group1's colour (edx = [rbx + pal.group1], rbx = the RenderSystemResource); Kiln's mid hook replaces edx

outline/Palette0.Group2.comment: the same function's call for Group2 (edx = [rbx + pal.group2])

outline/Palette1.Group1.comment: the second palette function's call for Group1
